sentences.text: 3. Learned Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is the father-in-law of victim and similarly situated co-accused Sakil Ansari (Bhainsur) of victim has been granted bail by this Bench in B.A.No. 11310 of 2022 vide order dated 12.12.2022 which is appended with this Bail Application as Annexure-2.
The applicant has been languishing in Jail since 25.11.2022.

4. As per F.I.R. allegation, the informant-victim had alleged that while she was studying in class-VIII, the brother-in- law of her sister Kamil Ansari had raped her on the pointing of knife and for last two years he had been sexually exploiting her on the pretext of marriage.
The informant-victim also became pregnant.
Ultimately on 15.02.2021 the informant was married with Kamil Ansari.
Thereafter all the named accused in the F.I.R. made demand of Rs.5,00,000/- in cash in additional dowry and for non-fulfilment of the same informant-victim was subjected to cruelty.
5. The present applicant is the father-in-law of victim.
The allegation in regard to demand of dowry and for non- fulfilment of the same subjected her to cruelty is against the family members of Kamil Ansari which is general and omnibus.
The case of the applicant is identical to that of Sakil Ansari who has been granted bail vide order dated 12.12.2022 in B.A.No. 11310 of 2022.
Mokil Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand.

6. Learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State vehemently opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the applicant.
7. In view of the submissions made and materials on record, the bail application of the applicant is hereby allowed.
Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.

(Subhash Chand, J.) P.K.S.
